messages:
jen_k: Heads-up — we're getting a cluster of SSE clients reporting 'stream closed' mid-request in us-west today, ~09:12-09:18 PST. Not normal volume but high error-to-success ratio. :thinking:
omar_s: Yup. Saw billing duplicates for a few customers who retried after the close. Looks like the client retries and we double-count tokens.
jen_k: Minimal repro: server sends a 204/empty event then socket FIN. Client treats as terminal and triggers retry. Logs: ```[proxy] 2026-03-18T16:12:05Z -> proxy->edge: event chunked; bytes=128
[upstream] 2026-03-18T16:12:05Z -> model: keepalive
[proxy] 2026-03-18T16:12:05Z -> proxy: sent 204, halfclose
[client] 2026-03-18T16:12:05Z -> client: reconnect+retry```
lucy_devex: Is the 204 coming from our runtime (quantized backend) or from the proxy layer? Maria — any telemetry traces? :eyes:
maria_obs: Traces show the 204 flagged at the proxy with response_reason=partial_close, upstream status=null. We have some p50 latency spikes at the same minute. Dashboard sampling is low so it's noisy but consistent across 3 hosts.
kai_sre: Could be the new keepalive/idle-ttl change we rolled yesterday. Related to ws/sse idle drain? I pushed a small change to the socket pool config at 02:00.
jen_k: @kai_sre that aligns. However, we should avoid emitting 204 when there is still an in-flight token accounting unit. This is the idempotency gap. We need either: 1) mark the stream event as retriable but avoid double-billing, or 2) make resume idempotent at billing layer.
omar_s: For short-term mitigation can we: a) widen retry-budget on edge so clients don't retry aggressively or b) add a header `X-Stream-Closure-Reason: partial;safe=false` so console can show it?
lucy_devex: Adding a header helps ops and customers but doesn't fix billing. I prefer explicit closure event emitted to console and logs so our billing pipeline can ignore retries within X seconds if original stream closed with reason=partial_close.
kai_sre: Quick patch idea: when proxy decides to half-close, annotate session metadata with `closed_reason=partial_close` and set `session_tombstone_ttl=30s`. Billing pipeline can dedupe events with same session_id within TTL. Low-risk and reversible.
maria_obs: We can emit a distinct metric: `stream.close.reason.partial_close` with tags (host, shard, model, route). I'll add it and create a Grafana panel. Also add a latent alert: trigger when partial_close_rate > 0.5% of total closes over 5m.
jen_k: Sounds good. Who owns the patch? @kai_sre for proxy metadata, @maria_obs for metrics/dashboards, @lucy_devex for customer-facing note and ops playbook.
kai_sre: I'll open a small PR for proxy annotation and tombstone TTL. Plan: revert knob if it causes regressions.
omar_s: For billing dedupe I can add a filter rule on ingestion to drop duplicates if session_tombstone exists within timeframe. I'll coordinate with finance to ensure this won't mask real charge disagreements.
maria_obs: Dashboard plan: add panel, add sampling log link to request traces. Also create a runbook entry: steps to identify affected tenants, edge hosts, and how to toggle tombstone TTL per shard.
lucy_devex: I'll draft a short status blurb for console incidents page and a customer message template (avoid saying 'we double-billed' until we've verified).
jen_k: Minor UX ask: can console show streaming closure reason in request details? Right now the console shows only final status code and latency. If we show `closure_reason` it helps devs triage.
maria_obs: We can enrich request details from telemetry pipeline with `closure_reason`. Low effort once proxy emits the field.
kai_sre: Rolling canary for the proxy annotation now. deploy-bot: canary rollout started: proxy-service v2.14.3 -> hosts 3/40.
deply-bot: oops typo in bot handle above — ignore.
omar_s: After canary, let's watch: partial_close metric, billing ingestion duplicates, and console error noise. If safe, promote.
jen_k: Timeline: kai will PR and roll canary today. Maria adds panels and alert. Omar will draft ingestion rule. Lucy will draft comms. We'll sync in 45m.
jen_k: Quick debug snippet in case you need it: ```curl -H "Accept: text/event-stream" https://edge.redwood.ai/v1/stream -v``` look for `Connection: close` while payload backlog > 0.
maria_obs: Added dashboard panel and alert. Alert threshold conservative for canary.
kai_sre: Canary shows 0.2% reduction in duplicates so far. Rolling to 10% hosts.
omar_s: Billing ingestion rule ready in staging. Finance review queued.
lucy_devex: Drafted customer note + internal playbook. Keeping language neutral.
jen_k: OK team — try to avoid any large rollbackable changes. If we see new 5xx or stream failure regressions, rollback immediately. Meeting in 45. :thumbsup:
